title.zh: 医疗注册（新加坡医药理事会成员——豁免）命令 2024
title.en: Medical Registration (Member of Singapore Medical Council — Exemption) Order 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Medical Registration (Member of Singapore Medical Council — Exemption) Order 2024 and comes into operation on 28 June 2024.
2. Section 8(b) of the Act does not apply to Professor Sung Jao Yiu, for so long as he remains the Dean of the Lee Kong Chian School of Medicine at Nanyang Technological University, Singapore.
